steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Allocate approximately 1 minute per mark: a 3-mark question gets about 3 minutes; leave 5–10 minutes at the end for checking | Key Fact: Attempt every question — there are no negative marks; even an educated guess on a multiple-choice question is worthwhile | Key Fact: Check answers systematically: re-read the question, verify units, confirm calculations, and apply reasonableness checks | Key Fact: When checking, work backwards from your answer or use an alternative method to verify; if both methods agree, the answer is likely correct
